pages.text: Summons multiple rolling crushing wheels that knock back enemies along their path. Damage is determined by the total stress of the bound network — defaults to 1 damage per 2000 stress, configurable in the config file.$(br)Right-click a $(l:goetymech_machines/stress_reader)Stress Reader$(/l) to bind the focus to a network; sneak + right-click to unbind. If a $(l:goetymech_machines/stress_ark)Stress Ark$(/l) exists, manual binding is not required.$(br)$(4)"These crushing wheels aren't just good for crushing items — they're great for ramming people too!"$()
